def.short: a government member in charge of one area, such as health or education
def.long: A senior member of the government who is in charge of one department, such as education, health or finance. In many countries, the head of the government is the Prime Minister.

grammar.pattern: the Minister of/for sth; the health minister

examples.en: The health minister spoke on TV last night.
examples.tr: Sağlık bakanı dün akşam televizyonda konuştu.

examples.en: The Minister of Education announced changes to the exam system.
examples.tr: Eğitim Bakanı sınav sisteminde değişiklikler açıkladı.

examples.en: The minister answered questions from journalists after the meeting.
examples.tr: Bakan, toplantıdan sonra gazetecilerin sorularını yanıtladı.

tr.note: Bakanlık 'ministry' olur: 'the Ministry of Health' (Sağlık Bakanlığı). Başbakan 'Prime Minister' olarak geçer.

quiz.cloze: The prime ______ met the president in Paris yesterday.

def.short: the group of people who are elected to make the laws of a country
def.long: The group of people elected by the voters to make and change the laws of a country and to discuss important national issues. In the UK, its members are called MPs.

grammar.pattern: in parliament; be elected to parliament

examples.en: Parliament will vote on the new law today.
examples.tr: Meclis yeni yasayı bugün oylayacak.

examples.en: She was elected to parliament in 2023.
examples.tr: 2023'te meclise seçildi.

examples.en: The debate in parliament went on until midnight.
examples.tr: Mecliste tartışma gece yarısına kadar sürdü.

tr.note: Bir ülkenin meclisi kastedildiğinde çoğu zaman 'the' almadan kullanılır: 'Parliament voted...', 'in parliament'. Milletvekili 'member of parliament (MP)' olur.

mistakes.wrong: The new law was accepted in the parliament.
mistakes.right: The new law was passed by parliament.
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'yasa kabul edildi' deriz ve 'kabul etmek' accept diye çevrilir. İngilizcede yasalar 'pass' edilir: 'The law was passed.'

quiz.cloze: The new law must be passed by ______ before it can start.

entries.sense_note: person who votes in an election

def.short: a person who chooses a candidate or party in an election
def.long: A person who has the right to choose a candidate or a party in an election. Before an election, politicians make many promises to win their support.

examples.en: Young voters care about jobs and housing.
examples.tr: Genç seçmenler iş ve konut konularını önemsiyor.

examples.en: Many voters stayed at home because of the rain.
examples.tr: Birçok seçmen yağmur yüzünden evde kaldı.

examples.en: This is the first election for about two million new voters.
examples.tr: Bu, yaklaşık iki milyon yeni seçmen için ilk seçim.

tr.note: 'Vote' (oy; oy vermek) kelimesinden gelir. Oy kullanmak 'vote' ya da 'cast a vote' olur.

quiz.cloze: On election day, long lines of ______ waited outside the polling stations.

def.short: a situation in which all people have the same rights and chances
def.long: A situation in which everyone has the same rights, chances and treatment, whatever their sex, race, age or religion. Gender equality means men and women are treated the same way.

examples.en: We believe in equality for all.
examples.tr: Herkes için eşitliğe inanıyoruz.

examples.en: The company says it supports equality between men and women.
examples.tr: Şirket, kadınlarla erkekler arasında eşitliği desteklediğini söylüyor.

examples.en: Many people still fight for equality in education.
examples.tr: Birçok insan hâlâ eğitimde eşitlik için mücadele ediyor.

quiz.cloze: The new law aims to give men and women more ______ at work.

def.short: something that a person or group says or writes officially, especially in public
def.long: Something that a person or organization says or writes officially and publicly, for example to give information or an opinion about an event. Companies often make one after a problem.

grammar.pattern: make/issue a statement; in a statement

examples.en: The club made a short statement this morning.
examples.tr: Kulüp bu sabah kısa bir açıklama yaptı.

examples.en: In a statement, the company said no one was hurt.
examples.tr: Şirket yaptığı açıklamada kimsenin yaralanmadığını söyledi.

examples.en: The police will give a statement to the press at 5 p.m.
examples.tr: Polis saat 17.00'de basına bir açıklama yapacak.

tr.note: Resmî bir duyuru için 'statement' denir; bir şeyin nedenini anlatmak ise 'explanation' olur. Banka hesap dökümüne de 'bank statement' denir.

mistakes.wrong: The minister made an explanation to the press.
mistakes.right: The minister made a statement to the press.
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'açıklama' hem resmî duyuru hem de bir şeyi anlatma demektir. Basına yapılan resmî açıklama 'statement' olur; 'explanation' bir şeyin nedenini anlatmaktır.

quiz.cloze: The president's office will release an official ______ later today.

def.short: a set of questions you ask many people to find out what they think or do
def.long: A set of questions that you ask a large number of people to find out their opinions or habits. News reports often begin with 'A new one shows that...'.

grammar.pattern: do/carry out a survey; a survey shows

examples.en: A new survey shows that most people sleep less than seven hours.
examples.tr: Yeni bir anket, çoğu insanın yedi saatten az uyuduğunu gösteriyor.

examples.en: Can you fill in this short survey about our service?
examples.tr: Hizmetimizle ilgili bu kısa anketi doldurabilir misiniz?

examples.en: The council carried out a survey of local residents.
examples.tr: Belediye, mahalle sakinleriyle bir anket yaptı.

tr.note: Anket yapmak 'do / carry out a survey', anketi doldurmak 'fill in / fill out a survey' olur.

mistakes.wrong: We made a survey with 500 students.
mistakes.right: We did a survey of 500 students.
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'anket yapmak' deriz ve 'yapmak' çoğu zaman 'make' diye çevrilir. Anket için 'do' ya da 'carry out' kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: Please take five minutes to fill in our customer ______.

def.short: numbers that give information about how often something happens or how much
def.long: Numbers and facts collected to show information about a situation, for example how many people do not have a job.

examples.en: The statistics show a big rise in prices.
examples.tr: İstatistikler fiyatlarda büyük bir artış olduğunu gösteriyor.

examples.en: According to official statistics, unemployment fell last year.
examples.tr: Resmî istatistiklere göre işsizlik geçen yıl azaldı.

examples.en: Crime statistics for the city will be published next month.
examples.tr: Şehrin suç istatistikleri gelecek ay yayımlanacak.

tr.note: Sayılar anlamında çoğul fiil alır: 'The statistics show...'. Bilim dalı anlamında tekil fiil alır: 'Statistics is a difficult subject.'

quiz.cloze: The latest ______ show that more young people are moving to big cities.

def.short: a general change or development in the way that things are happening
def.long: A general change in a situation or in the way people behave, which continues for some time. For example, more and more people now work from home.

grammar.pattern: a trend toward/in sth; follow a trend

examples.en: Working from home is a growing trend.
examples.tr: Evden çalışmak giderek yaygınlaşan bir eğilim.

examples.en: There's a clear trend toward smaller families in big cities.
examples.tr: Büyük şehirlerde daha küçük ailelere doğru belirgin bir eğilim var.

examples.en: Young people often follow fashion trends on social media.
examples.tr: Gençler çoğu zaman sosyal medyadaki moda akımlarını takip ediyor.

tr.note: Türkçede de 'trend' denir ama İngilizcede yalnızca moda için değil, ekonomi ve toplumdaki her genel değişim için kullanılır: 'a downward trend in sales' (satışlarda düşüş eğilimi).

quiz.cloze: Sales of electric cars have gone up every year; it's a clear ______.

def.short: ordinary people in general, not people who work for the government
def.long: Ordinary people in a country or area, not the government or experts. It is used with 'the', as in 'open to the public'.

grammar.pattern: the public; open/closed to the public

examples.en: The museum is open to the public on Sundays.
examples.tr: Müze pazar günleri halka açık.

examples.en: The government didn't tell the public the full story.
examples.tr: Hükümet halka olayın tamamını anlatmadı.

examples.en: The park will be closed to the public until May.
examples.tr: Park mayısa kadar halka kapalı olacak.

tr.note: Sıfat olarak 'kamuya ait, herkese açık' demektir: 'public transport' (toplu taşıma). İsim olarak 'the' ile kullanılır: 'the public'.

quiz.cloze: The new swimming pool will open to the ______ next month.

entries.sense_note: money or goods given to help

def.micro: gift of money to help people
def.short: money or things that you give to a charity or organization to help people
def.long: Money, food, clothes or other things that you give to a charity, hospital or other organization to help people. After a disaster, many people give money in this way.

examples.en: Every donation, big or small, helps.
examples.tr: Büyük küçük her bağış işe yarar.

examples.en: Ayşe made a donation to the children's hospital.
examples.tr: Ayşe çocuk hastanesine bağış yaptı.

examples.en: After the floods, donations of food and blankets arrived from all over the country.
examples.tr: Sellerden sonra ülkenin her yerinden yiyecek ve battaniye bağışları geldi.

tr.note: Fiili 'donate' olur: 'donate money', 'donate blood'. 'Bağış yapmak' için 'make a donation' denir.

quiz.cloze: The animal shelter depends on ______ from the public to stay open.

def.short: newspapers, magazines and news websites, and the journalists who work for them
def.long: Newspapers, magazines, news websites and the journalists who work for them. Its freedom means journalists can report the news without control from the government.

examples.en: The minister refused to talk to the press.
examples.tr: Bakan basınla konuşmayı reddetti.

examples.en: The team will hold a press conference after the match.
examples.tr: Takım maçtan sonra bir basın toplantısı düzenleyecek.

examples.en: Freedom of the press is important in a democracy.
examples.tr: Basın özgürlüğü demokraside önemlidir.

tr.note: Gazeteciler topluca kastedildiğinde 'the' ile kullanılır: 'the press'. 'Basın toplantısı' 'press conference', 'basın bülteni' 'press release' olur.
tr.mnemonic: Gazeteler eskiden baskı makinesinde (printing press) basılırdı; Türkçedeki 'basın' da 'basmak' fiilinden gelir.

quiz.cloze: The actor didn't want to answer questions from the ______ about his private life.

entries.sense_note: person who lives in a place

def.micro: person who lives in a place
def.short: a person who lives in a particular house, street, town or country
def.long: A person who lives in a particular place, such as a building, street, town or country. News reports often say 'local residents' for people who live near something.

grammar.pattern: local residents; a resident of sth

examples.en: Local residents are unhappy about the new road.
examples.tr: Mahalle sakinleri yeni yoldan memnun değil.

examples.en: Residents of the building can use the gym for free.
examples.tr: Bina sakinleri spor salonunu ücretsiz kullanabilir.

examples.en: Some residents had to leave their homes because of the flood.
examples.tr: Bazı bölge sakinleri sel yüzünden evlerini terk etmek zorunda kaldı.

tr.note: Türkçede tek başına 'sakin' sessiz anlamına da gelir; bu kelime 'mahalle sakinleri' kalıbındaki 'sakin' demektir. Yurt dışında oturum izni olan kişiye de 'resident' denir.

quiz.cloze: Many ______ of the street signed a letter against the new parking rules.
